grammarSemantics.@name: Worker references resolve workerDefinitions only; independent checker additionally resolves checkerDefinitions. No executable/dynamic namespace lookup.
grammarSemantics.record: All named fields mandatory, no extra keys, exact native JSON types, keys order-insensitive. Empty record closed too.
grammarSemantics.enum: Typed exact one listed scalar. literal: deep typed equality to listed JSON value.
grammarSemantics.union: At least one alternative; null only where explicit null branch.
grammarSemantics.integer: Inclusive safe native integer range; JSON tokens no fraction/exponent/-0/coercion.
grammarSemantics.stringMax: Maximum UTF8 bytes; string must contain valid Unicode scalar values. Optional anchored pattern uses existing ECMAScript regexp semantics; no normalization. Pattern-only string also <=131072 UTF8 bytes.
grammarSemantics.boolean/null: Exact native JSON type, never string.
grammarSemantics.tuple: Exactly listed length and per-position element grammars; no rest items.
grammarSemantics.beforeParse: Duplicate decoded keys rejected at every nesting before object construction; bound raw input bytes before parse.
grammarSemantics.all: Closed schemas describe data shape only. Actual owned raw/native authentication, private same-module identities, current integrity, exact selected cell and no-call joins are mandatory; schema match never creates authority.
grammarSemantics.literal: Deep typed exact equality to the listed data, no subset/prefix matching or coercion. Checker native literals include the entire native13-key object.

externalMonitorMeaning: Finite proposed source-bound external monitor phase1500s+bounded60s cleanup; independent review required before any release; no actual process/time attestation.
namespaceRules: Worker pool resolves ONLY workerDefinitions; checker pool extends it with checkerDefinitions. Entire file has no exact native reply/candidate/plaintext payload or fullchecker native literal, only structural types and descriptor metadata. Workers never parse candidate/expected descriptor targets.
sourceFirst: SAME actual derivative executable sourceApproval and complete sourceClosure must precede CONTROL-only bootstrap, LOCAL primary, independent QA and eventual target manifests. LOCAL is a separate fixed invocation, never a missing-native-qualification waiver for target admission.
qualificationGate: Unchanged acceptedN nativeOracleEvidenceSet/nativeOracleQualification shapes and exact common JS+RUST subject joins remain in copiedworkerDefinitions. New backendEvidence descriptors become aggregate.actualEvidence.JS/RUST only after both runs complete; both final aggregate reviewers distinct/nonoperator/nonauthor.
noFutureArtifacts: Schemas/reference shapes only. No source approval, executable/tool closure, materialized request/expected object, control outcome, runtime config/release, run capture, evidence graph or qualification pack is supplied or claimed ready.
interpretation: IMPLEMENTATION.md defines fixed module APIs, CLI/config context, expected-data boundary, per-record semantic joins and failure custody. Static source preparation only; no project imports/evaluation/native/crypto/control/network/experiment execution authorized by this file.
